title: MAT-6 — HITL Asana approval triggers and callbacks
description: Wire formats for human-in-the-loop gates: orchestrator emits a trigger payload when MAT-4 queue status is blocked_hitl; an automation bridge creates or updates Asana work and later posts a callback so the orchestrator can resume, deny, or cancel the queue item.
notes: Link to MAT-4: trigger and callback both carry correlation_id (UUID) and queue_item_id matching queue.items[] while status is blocked_hitl.
Asana object identifiers are opaque string gids (digits); do not embed org URLs — automation resolves workspace/project from config.
Authentication, webhook signing, and Asana API calls are out of band; these schemas cover only JSON payloads exchanged with the orchestrator.
